# `tradeoff`

Return the feasible non-dominated pumping decisions for several stated MODFLOW 6 objectives using PESTPP-MOU.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| module | `pestpp` - 187 keywords in its dictionary, of which this template states 0 |
| solves | `trid3nt.workflows.pestpp.engine.solve_case` |
| engine defaults | every keyword this template does not state keeps the engine's own default; `describe_keywords` names it with that default, and `keywords={...}` sets it |

## The inputs

The values the template declares. `desc` is what the model reads when it fills one.

| input | units | default | desc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | - | required | Pinned native simulation files by deck filename, including mfsim.nam. |
| `model` | - | required | The GWF model name in the MODFLOW 6 simulation. |
| `decisions` | - | required | Decisions by name with package, one-based period and native cellid, lower and upper rate bounds and source. |
| `objectives` | - | required | Two or more native OBS forecasts with name, type, id, optional id2, package and model, one-based period and step, units and source. State each sense as min or max. |
| `constraints` | - | optional | Optional native OBS forecasts with the same selectors and source as the objectives. State each sense as <= or >= and its limit in the forecast's units. |
| `generations` | - | required | Positive number of PESTPP-MOU generations (noptmax). |
| `population` | - | required | Positive PESTPP-MOU population size. |
| `generator` | - | required | PESTPP-MOU generator: de, pso, sbx, pm or simplex. |
| `seed` | - | required | Unsigned integer seed for PEST++'s random number generator (rand_seed). |
